Most of the equipment Raytheon produces is sold to the US government.
en: a large US company started in 1922 and based in Waltham, Massachusetts. It operates in areas such as computers, technology, and engineering but is particularly known for the advanced weapons it produces, especially missiles (= weapons that are sent through the air and explode when they hit their target). Most of the equipment Raytheon produces is sold to the US government.
to completely destroy a building, town, etc. so that nothing is left
ex: The village was razed to the ground.
这座村庄被夷为平地。

en: an instrument that is used for removing hair by shaving
ex: a disposable razor
一次性剃须刀

en: a thin sharp piece of metal that is used in a razor, especially one that can be thrown away when it is no longer sharp

zh: a shellfish that can be eaten. It has a long thin shell in two parts that can open and close.
en: a shellfish that can be eaten. It has a long thin shell in two parts that can open and close.

zh: 尖利铁丝网，刺钢丝（墙头及土地周围防护用）
en: strong wire with small sharp points or blades sticking out, placed on top of walls and around areas of land to keep people out
ex: a fence topped with razor wire
顶部有带刺钢丝的栅栏

en: extremely sharp
ex: razor-sharp teeth
十分锋利的牙齿

zh: 以微弱优势取胜的；险胜的
en: won by a very small number of votes
ex: The Republican Senator won a third term by a razor-thin edge over his Democratic challenger.
共和党参议员以其精简的优势赢得了第三任期，胜过他的民主党挑战者。

zh: 刀嘴海雀（产于北大西洋和波罗的海）
en: a black and white bird with a beak that looks like an old-fashioned razor, found in the N Atlantic and the Baltic Sea
to tease somebody by saying or doing things to make people laugh at them
a lot of noisy, exciting activity that is intended to attract people’s attention
ex: The documentary focuses on the razzmatazz of an American political campaign.
这部纪录片着重展现一场美国政治运动令人眼花缭乱的一面。

zh: a run scored by a player in the field as a result of another player who has hit the ball and who gets credit for the run (the abbreviation for ‘run batted in’)
en: a run scored by a player in the field as a result of another player who has hit the ball and who gets credit for the run (the abbreviation for ‘run batted in’)
ex: He finished the season with five RBIs.
他以五个RBI结束了本赛季。

zh: release candidate (a version of a product, especially computer software, that is fully developed and nearly ready to be made available to the public. It comes after the beta version.)

圣玛丽皇家教堂

阿什顿路 12 号
